composable_tv Wave 0 [w5] — post-hoc deterministic sparsification grid on the Llama-2-7B e5 per-author r32 pool (zero-training preview of the ctv arms; driver sparsify_pool.py, CPU only — run as a CPU SLURM job, never the login node). Ops: dare

= Bernoulli drop on B/A entries with per-(author,tensor) SHA-256 seeds, survivors /(1-p); topk = keep top q rows of B by norm (per-task-local); hash = seeded global row permutation -> N disjoint blocks, author keeps its subset-position block (the [wd] rowslice preview). Compose via merge_subset._weighted_factor_cat, weights 1/N (dare/topk, additive_mean-matched) or 1.0 (hash, disjoint sum). Labels sparse__N_s42; eval manifest = 4-col nmerge format (headline = the perm[0]=82 probe row). DX: --dx1 cancellation-vs-null at dx1.n_values (W3 headroom contract), --dx2 owned-row energy at the grid Ns. probe_authors is documentation — runtime derives probes from merge_subset.probe_authors(pool_seed) and cross-checks. Paths are repo-relative (checkpoints/ is the /storage2 symlink).
